not_recommended.name: Building a custom e-commerce platform
not_recommended.reason: Shopify, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce are mature and cost-effective; custom platforms cost 10-100x more to build and maintain
not_recommended.alternative: Use established platforms and customize with apps/plugins

not_recommended.name: Custom fraud detection system
not_recommended.reason: Fraud patterns evolve constantly; established providers have larger datasets for training ML models and offer chargeback guarantees
not_recommended.alternative: Use Shopify Protect, Signifyd, or Riskified for fraud prevention

not_recommended.name: Building your own email marketing platform
not_recommended.reason: Email deliverability, compliance (GDPR/CAN-SPAM), and infrastructure are complex; established platforms handle this
not_recommended.alternative: Use Klaviyo, Omnisend, or Mailchimp with custom integrations

not_recommended.name: Headless commerce migration for stores under EUR 2M
not_recommended.reason: Initial costs EUR 50,000-150,000 for mid-market; 12-24 months for full migration. ROI doesn't justify for SMBs.
not_recommended.alternative: Use Shopify or WooCommerce with native AI tools. Headless is only justified above EUR 2M revenue with specific performance/customization needs.

not_recommended.name: Custom ESG/sustainability reporting for SMBs
not_recommended.reason: EU CSRD scope was narrowed in Dec 2025 (Omnibus Package) to companies with 1,000+ employees and EUR 450M+ turnover. SMBs are exempt from mandatory reporting.
not_recommended.alternative: Focus on voluntary sustainability messaging for brand differentiation; use marketplace eco-badges where available

forward_looking.name: Agentic Commerce (AI agents buying on behalf of consumers)
forward_looking.description: AI agents that autonomously browse, compare, and purchase products. McKinsey estimates $3-5 trillion in agent-mediated commerce by 2030.
